notes: 'doeth it' and 'his own' are two added runs rather than one, since the rendered preposition 'to' stands between them (rule 2).

אִישׁ רֵעִים is one nominal recast as a head noun plus a relative clause of making, so the supplied antecedent, relative and verb belong to that noun's unit and head on 'maketh' (rules 46, 43); the marginal gloss 'A man of friends' corroborates without deciding (rule 38).
'closer' is read as the degree word of the comparative מִן, headed on 'than' (rule 24); keeping it with the attributive participle דָּבֵק was the competing reading.
